title: Derived extension left adjoint to exact scalar restriction
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings and ρ:R→B a ring homomorphism. Choose derived localizations of their module categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There exists a functor E:D(R)→D(B) left adjoint to termwise exact restriction of scalars. E is the left derived extension of scalars, computed on K-flat resolutions, with no flatness assumption on ρ.

proof.text: Apply mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso with the B-unit single complex and use the single-complex tensor and left-unitor isomorphisms to show extension preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes.

Apply the derivedAdjunction theorem to ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj; exact restriction has its right-derived functor naturally isomorphic to mapDerivedCategory. Transport the adjunction through this isomorphism and package the left-derived extension.

theorem mixedGlobalExtension_adjunction {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B]
    (ρ : R →+* B) :
    ∃ E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B),
      Nonempty (E ⊣ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} ρ).mapDerivedCategory)
